name: Mathieson's protocol droid
description: A protocol droid served Admiral Mathieson of the New Republic, recording every conversation the admiral had for five years. The protocol droid's head was stolen from the Brooksdion space station by a small team of Resistance operatives led by Vice Admiral Amilyn Holdo. The New Republic's Rapier Squadron, led by Commander Poe Dameron, attempted to pursue the thieves, but the Resistance vessel managed to escape with the protocol droid's head.
